records.rationale: `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb` unconditionally reloads the page every 30s (`setTimeout(function() { document.location.reload(); }, 30000);`) with no max-attempts/terminal state. In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil it always enqueues `:retrieve_topic` and renders `loading`. records.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the code does `url = i.link` then `url = i.id if url.blank? || url !~ /^https?\:\/\//`.
